name: Minagi Shiori
source:
She is a second-year student at Aoba Municipal High School and [url=/c105018]Kaoru[/url]'s classmate.
A beautiful and academically excellent student.
However, there is a thick invisible wall between her and those around her, and her true feelings are always kept hidden inside.
In front of [url=/c107507]Riku[/url], who has been her friend since middle school, she shows her absent-minded and stubborn side.
Although she was in the same class as Kaoru, she had hardly ever spoken to her. However, after a certain incident, they began to build a friendship, and she started to show an unexpected side of herself in front of Kaoru.

She tries to follow the same career path as her accomplished older brother and imitates his interests. She even goes so far as to declare to herself that "life has no value unless I become like my brother," which is almost to the point of being obsessive.

She adores a character named "Ushimocha," and her eyes light up whenever Ushimocha is mentioned.

[From [url=https://lycoris-works.com/usonatsu#character]official website[/url]]
